crossRefs.note: Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices.…
I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.
You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let’s exalt his name together.

translations.web: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
translations.bsb: I will praise God’s name in song and exalt Him with thanksgiving.
translations.kjv: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
translations.asv: I will praise the name of God with a song, And will magnify him with thanksgiving.
